rv.q: All in all, this is as sturdy a Turandot as one would wish, with some exceptional moments.
It's neither a roaring success nor disaster — rather, it's a performance that allows for an honest appraisal of both artists.
Unfortunately, it was the wrong kind.

cn.t: Zeffirelli's spectacular production dazzles with opulent sets and costumes, but the latest cast lacks chemistry and energy despite individual vocal prowess.
